title: Brick wall courses in four bonds
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of a brick wall in running, Flemish, English or stack bond, with recessed mortar, rounded and chipped edges and per-brick colour. Use for building walls, chimneys and garden walls.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python brick_courses.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: bond
parameters.meaning: 0 running (stretchers offset by half a brick), 1 Flemish (headers and stretchers alternate in each course), 2 English (stretcher and header courses alternate), 3 stack (joints aligned).

parameters.name: course_pairs
parameters.meaning: Pairs of courses across the tile height; every bond repeats after two courses.

parameters.name: bricks_per_course
parameters.meaning: Stretchers per course across the tile width (Flemish: header and stretcher pairs).

parameters.name: mortar_width
parameters.meaning: Joint width in texture units (fractions of the tile width).

parameters.name: joint_depth
parameters.meaning: How far the mortar sits below the brick faces: 0 flush, 1 deeply raked.

parameters.name: bevel
parameters.meaning: Width of the rounded brick edge in texture units.

parameters.name: chipping
parameters.meaning: Broken and eroded brick edges, 0 crisp to 1 heavily damaged.

parameters.name: grime
parameters.meaning: Soot and dirt in the joints and on the faces.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Red clay bricks in running bond with light grey mortar.

presets.name: weathered
presets.description: Old dark bricks, chipped edges, deep joints, soot and white salt bloom.

presets.name: flemish_buff
presets.description: Buff yellow bricks in Flemish bond with darker headers.

presets.name: english_brown
presets.description: Brown bricks in English bond with dark mortar.

presets.name: glazed_stack
presets.description: Glossy white glazed bricks in stack bond with thin flush joints.

limits: Bricks are flat rectangles with rounded edges; there are no corner returns, cut bricks or openings. The bond repeats every two courses, so a tile shows an even number of courses. Salt bloom, soot and chips are noise-driven approximations. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced. Colours are artistic, not measured from real clay.
technique_references: Running, Flemish, English and stack bond layouts in texture space
Per-cell hashing for brick colour and tilt
Fractional Brownian motion of tileable gradient noise
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
